title: An edit of a PR comment that holds a merge-tool review record is refused
why: Lane notes-fix-guard-1 (session_013NEJL3G6vFtN2TjNZrMETW) hand-edited the tool-printed review records on #1926, #1531, #2016 and #1989, and nothing stopped it (coordinator, 09:03 CST Nov 8).
note: Done check: a red test where an edit of a review-record comment is refused, by `gh api -X PATCH .../comments/<id>`, `gh pr comment --edit-last` or MCP update_issue_comment; the remedy is to post a fresh record. Not part of review-record-parse-warn, which flags a record that does not parse, not an edit. Nearest home: review-record-provenance (only the merge tool may post a record); the lane extends that guard rather than a copy. Filed by triage 09:02 CST Nov 8. Sent by the coordinator 09:03 CST Nov 8 to lane review-record-provenance as a follow-up on #1634. The finding lane's own proposal review-record-no-edit (refuse an update_issue_comment whose body or target opens with the review-record marker; the coordinator ruled a record is never hand-edited) is this step. Sighting (coordinator 16:52 CST Nov 8): two more lanes today edited a record comment by hand after the merge tool refused (#2294, #2251). Read-side fix shape: `merge --reviewed` reads a record comment whose updated_at differs from its created_at as hand-edited, flags it and does not count it. No extra reads, since the comments are already read.
